crossRefs.note: “Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of…
He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.
I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.
When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things…
Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.
“The vision of the evenings and mornings which has been told is true; but seal up the vision, for it belongs to many…
But you, Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and…
He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.
What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for…
Wail, for Yahweh’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.
Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a…
The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor…
Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be, unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is…
But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

translations.web: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.
translations.bsb: Then he told me, “Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, because the time is near.
translations.kjv: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
translations.asv: And he saith unto me, Seal not up the words of the prophecy of this book; for the time is at hand.
